connector.name: Opik MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Interact with Opik prompts, traces, datasets and metrics through the Model Context Protocol.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package opik-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the comet-ml account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.description: Override the API base URL when using a self-hosted Opik deployment.

env.name: OPIK_WORKSPACE_NAME
env.description: Default workspace to scope prompt and trace operations.
